task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Central coordination: draft and issue the emergency edict, set epidemic policy, and supervise all ministries' implementation
Lead the medical and ritual response: mobilize physicians and medical offices, distribute medicines, treat the sick in affected cities, and conduct epidemic rites
Finance and logistics: release silver and grain reserves for relief, fund medicines and food aid, and grant temporary tax remission to the affected cities
